title: BEAR Resource Error (Compact)
description: Compact schema for BEAR Resource error logging - exception as complete string

exceptionId.description: Unique identifier for this exception occurrence

exceptionAsString.description: Complete exception information as string (class, message, stack trace, file, line)

xhprof_file.description: Path to XHProf profiling data file (optional)

xdebug_trace_file.description: Path to Xdebug trace file for detailed execution flow (optional)
